mainTopic: Offering blood or animals outside the עזרה: liability for שיריים versus דחוי blood, and the new פרק's rule that only animals fit for the מזבח bring liability.
overview: The גמרא asks why the משנה makes a person חייב for offering leftover blood (שיריים) outside the עזרה after the main placement was already done inside. It answers that the משנה follows רבי נחמיה, who holds there is liability for שיריים. A later case in the same משנה has two cups: one placed inside and one outside, and there the person is פטור. To explain this, the גמרא says that part follows the תנא קמא, who holds that one cup makes the other cup דחוי (rejected). The משנה compares this to a lost חטאת that turned up after a replacement was set aside. The גמרא explains that the comparison follows רבי, for whom such an animal is put to death. A backup animal set aside on purpose, by contrast, counts as an עולה. When the גמרא objects that a female חטאת can never be an עולה, רב חייא מיוסתיניא answers that the case is the male שעיר נשיא. The פרק then ends. A new פרק opens: there is no liability outside for the פרה אדומה, the שעיר המשתלח, or animals that are disqualified from the מזבח, because only an animal fit to be brought before the משכן counts. The amud ends as the משנה begins the case of blemished animals.

steps.title: Why is offering the leftover blood outside punishable?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא accepts the first case of the משנה (outside first, then inside). It challenges the second case (inside first, then outside), because the blood left over is only שיריים.
steps.simpleTranslation: גמרא: It makes sense that if he first placed the blood outside and then inside, he is liable, because all of the blood was fit to go inside. But if he first placed it inside and then offered the rest outside, why is he liable? That blood is only leftovers!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא begins discussing the משנה. It questions one of the two cases where the משנה says a person is חייב.
steps.deeperAnalysis: When the blood is placed outside first, the מצוה inside has not been done yet, so the blood outside was fully 'real' blood fit for the מזבח. When the blood is placed inside first, the מצוה is already done. What remains is only שיריים, which seems too unimportant to make someone liable for offering it outside.

keyTerms.meaning: It makes sense / granted (the first case is fine; the next one is the problem)
Outside the עזרה (the Temple courtyard)
Inside the עזרה, on the real מזבח
Leftover blood that remains after the required placement is done
They are

steps.confusionAlert: The phrase 'שכולו ראוי להיות בפנים' is the משנה's reason. The גמרא agrees that this reason works for the first case. It only questions whether the reason also works for the second case.

phrases.english: GEMARA: Granted, if he placed it outside
and then went back and placed it inside —
that is because all of it was fit to be placed inside;
but if he placed it inside and then offered the rest outside —
that is only leftover blood!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Opens the גמרא's discussion of the משנה.
steps.kashyaTarget: The משנה's ruling that one is חייב when he places the blood inside first and then outside.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: Once the blood has been placed inside, the rest is only שיריים. Offering שיריים outside should not create liability.

steps.title: The משנה follows רבי נחמיה
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא answers that the משנה follows רבי נחמיה. He holds that one is liable for offering שיריים outside.
steps.simpleTranslation: Whose view is this? It is רבי נחמיה's, who says: if someone offers the leftover blood outside, he is liable.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the question by naming the תנא whose view the משנה follows.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The question assumed that שיריים are not important enough to create liability. רבי נחמיה disagrees: in his view, offering שיריים outside does make a person liable. So according to him, the second case of the משנה is no problem.

keyTerms.meaning: Whose view is this?
The leftover blood
Liable (here, for offering outside the עזרה)

phrases.english: Whose view is this? It is רבי נחמיה's,
who says: the leftover blood
that one offered outside — he is liable.

steps.terutzResolutionType: Attributing the משנה to a specific תנא (רבי נחמיה).
steps.terutzHavaAmina: One would think שיריים offered outside can never create liability.
steps.terutzMaskana: According to רבי נחמיה, offering שיריים outside does create liability, so the משנה works.

steps.title: The סיפא with two cups does not fit רבי נחמיה
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא challenges the answer. In the סיפא, the blood is in two cups; if one cup is placed inside and the other outside, he is פטור. That seems to go against רבי נחמיה.
steps.simpleTranslation: If it is רבי נחמיה, look at the end of the משנה: if he collected the blood in two cups and placed both inside, he is exempt. If he placed both outside, he is liable. If he placed one inside and one outside, he is exempt. But רבי נחמיה says that one is liable for leftover blood offered outside!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא attacks its own answer. It quotes the last part of the משנה, which seems to contradict רבי נחמיה's view.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In the case of one cup inside and one outside, the second cup comes after the מצוה is done, so it looks like שיריים. If the משנה followed רבי נחמיה, the person should be חייב. Yet the משנה says פטור, so the סיפא cannot easily follow רבי נחמיה.

keyTerms.meaning: Say the last part (of the משנה)
Cups (vessels used to collect the blood)
Exempt (not liable)
But didn't he say? (introduces a contradiction)

phrases.english: If it is רבי נחמיה, say the last part of the משנה:
if he collected its blood in two cups;
if he placed both of them inside — he is exempt.
Both of them outside — he is liable.
One inside and one outside — he is exempt.
But doesn't רבי נחמיה say:
the leftover blood that one offered outside — he is liable!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges the answer of Step 2 by using the סיפא of the same משנה.
steps.kashyaTarget: The claim in Step 2 that the משנה follows רבי נחמיה.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: In the סיפא, the second cup offered outside looks like שיריים, yet the משנה says פטור. That goes against רבי נחמיה, who holds there is liability for שיריים.

steps.title: The סיפא follows the תנא קמא: one cup makes the other rejected
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא answers that the סיפא follows a different תנא, the תנא קמא who argues with רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון. He holds that once one cup is used, the other cup becomes דחוי (rejected).
steps.simpleTranslation: In the last part we come to the first תנא who argues with רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון. He says: one cup makes the other cup rejected.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא resolves the problem. It says the סיפא of the משנה is taught by a different תנא than the רישא.
steps.deeperAnalysis: According to this תנא קמא, once the first cup is placed inside, the second cup is not just שיריים. It becomes דחוי, disqualified blood. Offering disqualified blood outside creates no liability, which is why the סיפא says פטור.

keyTerms.meaning: We have come to (the view of)
The first, unnamed תנא in a dispute
Rejected / disqualified (blood that is no longer fit)

steps.whatToRemember: The רישא follows רבי נחמיה: offering שיריים outside makes one חייב. The סיפא follows the תנא קמא: a second cup becomes דחוי, not שיריים, so offering it outside makes one פטור.
steps.confusionAlert: Do not mix up שיריים (leftover blood that is still valid) with דחוי (blood that has become disqualified). The whole answer depends on the second cup being דחוי rather than שיריים.
steps.whyThisMatters: This shows that the רישא and the סיפא of one משנה can follow different תנאים. It also shows the difference between leftover blood and blood that has been made invalid.

phrases.english: In the last part we come to the first תנא
who argues with רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון,
who says: one cup makes its fellow cup rejected.
phrases.notes: Once the first cup's blood is placed, the blood in the second cup is no longer fit at all.

steps.triggerLanguage: סֵיפָא אֲתָאן לְתַנָּא קַמָּא דְּרַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר בְּרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן
steps.terutzResolutionType: Splitting the משנה: the סיפא follows a different תנא than the רישא.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The whole משנה follows רבי נחמיה, so the second cup should count as שיריים and make him חייב.
steps.terutzMaskana: The סיפא follows the תנא קמא, who holds the second cup becomes דחוי. Offering דחוי blood outside creates no liability.

steps.title: The משנה's comparison: a lost sin offering that was later found
steps.stepSummary: The משנה compares the case of the two cups to someone whose חטאת was lost, who set aside another, and then found the first.
steps.simpleTranslation: To what is this like? To someone who set aside his sin offering and it got lost. He set aside another one in its place, and afterward the first one was found.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא quotes the next line of the משנה, which gives a comparison for the ruling about the two cups of blood. This sets up the גמרא's question in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה had said that if one cup was put inside and then the other was offered outside, he is פטור. Now it compares the second cup to a lost חטאת that turned up after a replacement was already set aside. The comparison suggests the second cup has the same status as that lost animal.

keyTerms.meaning: To what is this matter comparable? A formula that introduces a comparison
One who sets aside an animal for a specific offering
Sin offering
It got lost

phrases.english: To what is the matter comparable?
To one who separates his sin offering and it was lost,
and he separated another one in its place,
and afterward the first one was found.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the סיפא of the משנה, the two-cups case discussed in steps 3–4, by adding the משנה's own comparison.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The second cup is compared to a lost חטאת that was found after a replacement had been set aside.

steps.title: Why does the משנה need this comparison?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks what the comparison adds to the משנה's ruling.
steps.simpleTranslation: Why do I need the line 'To what is this matter comparable'?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks why the משנה bothered to give a comparison at all. This sets up the explanation that follows.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The ruling about the two cups was already stated, so the comparison seems extra. The גמרא assumes every line of a משנה teaches something, so it wants to know what new point the comparison makes.

keyTerms.meaning: Why do I need it? Asks what a line adds

phrases.english: Why do I need "To what is the matter comparable"?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Questions why the line quoted in step 5 is needed.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: What the comparison to the lost חטאת adds beyond the ruling itself.

steps.title: The משנה follows רבי: a sin offering lost when its replacement was set aside is put to death
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא says the משנה follows רבי, who holds that a חטאת lost at the time a replacement is set aside must be put to death.
steps.simpleTranslation: Whose opinion is this? It is רבי, who said: an animal that was lost at the time of setting aside the replacement is put to death.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא starts its answer by saying which תנא the משנה follows: רבי.
steps.deeperAnalysis: According to רבי, if the first חטאת was lost when the owner set aside a replacement, it becomes fully rejected and is put to death. So the משנה is comparing the second cup to something completely disqualified, not just extra.

keyTerms.meaning: At the time of setting aside the replacement
It is left to die; it cannot be used

phrases.english: Whose is this? It is רבי;
who said: One that was lost at the time of separation is put to death.
phrases.notes: This is the first animal, which was missing when the owner set aside its replacement.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Begins answering the question of step 6 by naming the תנא behind the משנה.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The משנה follows רבי, for whom a חטאת lost at the time of separation is put to death.

steps.title: What the comparison teaches: only a lost animal is rejected, not a backup
steps.stepSummary: The comparison teaches that the exemption comes from the animal being lost. If he set aside two חטאות as a backup, the extra one is really an עולה from the start.
steps.simpleTranslation: And this is what the משנה is saying: the reason is that it was lost. But if he set aside two sin offerings as a backup, one of them was an עולה from the very beginning.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא finishes its answer by explaining exactly what point the comparison makes.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The extra animal is fully rejected only because it was lost when the replacement was set aside. If two animals were set aside from the start as a backup, the unused one is not rejected; it counts as an עולה. So the second cup is פטור only because it is rejected, like the lost animal. If it were just extra, he would be liable.

keyTerms.meaning: And this is what it means to say
The reason is
As a backup, in case one is lost
Burnt offering

steps.confusionAlert: Don't think every extra animal is rejected. Only one that was lost at the time of setting aside the replacement is put to death. A backup set aside on purpose counts as an עולה.
steps.whatToRemember: The comparison in the משנה teaches that the second cup is פטור because it is truly rejected, like a lost חטאת according to רבי. Something that is only extra, like a backup animal, would still make him liable outside.

phrases.english: And this is what it is saying:
The reason is that it was lost;
but if he separated two sin offerings as a guarantee —
one of them is a burnt offering from the start.
phrases.notes: He means the one he ends up not bringing as his חטאת.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Completes the answer of step 7 by drawing the practical lesson from רבי's view.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The comparison limits the exemption to a truly rejected item. A backup animal set aside on purpose is an עולה, so offering it outside would make him liable.

steps.title: Support from רב הונא: a guilt offering sent to graze is valid as a burnt offering
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא backs up the idea that the backup is an עולה with רב הונא's ruling: an אשם sent to graze that was slaughtered without a stated purpose is valid as an עולה.
steps.simpleTranslation: This is like רב הונא said in the name of רב: a guilt offering that was sent off to graze, and someone slaughtered it without saying what it was for, is valid as a burnt offering.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a ruling from רב הונא in the name of רב to support what it just said about the backup animal.
steps.deeperAnalysis: An אשם sent to graze would normally wait until it gets a blemish, and the money from selling it buys an עולה. רב says the animal itself is already valid as an עולה. In the same way, the unused backup חטאת counts as an עולה from the start, so offering it outside would make him liable.

keyTerms.meaning: Guilt offering
Sent off to graze until it gets a blemish
Without stating a purpose
Valid

steps.whyThisMatters: This ruling shows that an animal sent to graze is not rejected. It is a valid עולה, and that is why a backup animal is different from a lost one.

phrases.english: And this is in line with what רב הונא said in the name of רב,
for רב הונא said that רב said:
A guilt offering that was moved to grazing,
and he slaughtered it without specifying —
it is valid as a burnt offering.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Supports the claim in step 8 that the unused backup is an עולה from the start.
steps.raayaObject: That an animal left over and sent to graze is a valid עולה, not a rejected animal.
steps.raayaSupportSource: רב הונא in the name of רב: an אשם sent to graze and slaughtered without a stated purpose is valid as an עולה.

steps.title: A female חטאת cannot become an עולה
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks how the case of the אשם can prove anything about a חטאת. An אשם and an עולה are both male, but a חטאת is female.
steps.simpleTranslation: Are these cases really the same? There, an אשם is a male and an עולה is a male. But a חטאת is a female!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא attacks the proof from the previous step. It says the case of the אשם is different from the case of the חטאת.
steps.deeperAnalysis: An אשם can turn into an עולה because both offerings use a male animal. A regular חטאת is a female animal, and a female can never be brought as an עולה. So the backup חטאת cannot be treated as an עולה from the start.

keyTerms.meaning: Are they comparable? (a way of saying two cases are different)
Male
Female

steps.confusionAlert: The גמרא is not saying a female animal cannot be a חטאת. It is saying a female animal cannot be an עולה, so the backup חטאת cannot be treated as an עולה.

phrases.english: Are they comparable?!
There, a guilt offering is a male,
phrases.notes: "There" means the ruling about the אשם brought in the last step.

phrases.english: and a burnt offering is a male;
but a sin offering is a female!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects the comparison used in step 9 as support for step 8.
steps.kashyaTarget: The claim that the backup חטאת is really an עולה, supported by the ruling about the אשם.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: An אשם can become an עולה only because both are male. A חטאת is female and can never be an עולה.

steps.title: The case is the male goat of a נשיא
steps.stepSummary: רב חייא מיוסתיניא answers that the משנה is talking about the שעיר נשיא. That חטאת is a male goat, so the backup can be an עולה.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב חייא from יוסתיניא said: The משנה is talking about the goat brought by a נשיא.
steps.whatsHappening: רב חייא מיוסתיניא answers the challenge. He limits the משנה to a חטאת that is a male animal.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The שעיר נשיא is a חטאת that uses a male goat. A male can be an עולה, so the comparison to the אשם works again. The backup animal can count as an עולה from the beginning.

keyTerms.meaning: The male goat a נשיא brings as his חטאת
The king or leader of the people

steps.whatToRemember: The idea that the extra backup is an עולה works only for a male חטאת, such as the שעיר נשיא.

phrases.english: Rav Chiyya from Yostiniya said:
It is about the goat of a נשיא.
phrases.notes: Unlike a regular person's חטאת, the נשיא brings a male goat.

steps.terutzResolutionType: Limiting the case (אוקימתא) to a male חטאת
steps.terutzHavaAmina: Every חטאת is female, so a backup חטאת could never be an עולה.
steps.terutzMaskana: The משנה is about the שעיר נשיא, a male חטאת, which can be an עולה.

steps.title: Hadran — Closing הַשּׁוֹחֵט וְהַמַּעֲלֶה
steps.stepSummary: The closing line of פרק הַשּׁוֹחֵט וְהַמַּעֲלֶה.
steps.simpleTranslation: We will come back to you, פרק הַשּׁוֹחֵט וְהַמַּעֲלֶה.
steps.whatsHappening: This line marks the end of the פרק. The next line begins a new פרק.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The הדרן is a closing formula. It shows that we are coming back to learn this פרק again. It does not add any new law.

keyTerms.meaning: We will return to you (said when finishing a פרק)

phrases.english: We will return to you, "One who slaughters and one who offers up"

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Closes the פרק after the last answer.
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: The פרק about slaughtering and offering outside the עזרה is finished.

steps.title: No liability for the פרה אדומה or the שעיר המשתלח outside
steps.stepSummary: The new פרק opens. The משנה rules that a person is exempt if he burns the פרה אדומה away from its place, or offers the שעיר המשתלח outside.
steps.simpleTranslation: משנה: If someone burned the פרה אדומה outside its pit, or offered the שעיר המשתלח outside, he is exempt.
steps.whatsHappening: A new פרק begins with a משנה. It lists two special animals that bring no punishment when offered outside.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Normally, slaughtering or offering a קרבן outside the עזרה brings a serious punishment. The פרה אדומה is burned on הר הזיתים, and the שעיר המשתלח is thrown off a cliff. Neither one is ever offered on the מזבח, so using them outside is not this sin.

keyTerms.meaning: The פרה אדומה, the red cow burned to make purifying ashes
Its pit, the set place where it is burned
The goat sent away on יום כיפור

steps.confusionAlert: The פרה אדומה is called a חטאת, but it is not offered on the מזבח like a regular חטאת.

phrases.english: MISHNA: A red heifer of purification
that one burned outside its pit,
and likewise the scapegoat
that one offered outside — he is exempt.

steps.triggerLanguage: מַתְנִי׳ פָּרַת חַטָּאת שֶׁשְּׂרָפָהּ חוּץ מִגִּתָּהּ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Opens a new פרק after the הדרן.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Burning the פרה אדומה outside its place, or offering the שעיר המשתלח outside, does not make one liable.

steps.title: The פסוק: only what can come to the אהל מועד
steps.stepSummary: The משנה brings a פסוק as the source for its ruling. Liability applies only to an animal that is fit to be brought to the entrance of the אהל מועד.
steps.simpleTranslation: As the פסוק says: "And he did not bring it to the entrance of the אהל מועד." Anything that is not fit to come to the entrance of the אהל מועד, one is not liable for it.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה gives the source for the ruling it just stated.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The פסוק punishes someone who did not bring his animal to the אהל מועד. So the sin applies only to an animal that should have been brought there as a קרבן. The פרה אדומה and the שעיר המשתלח are never brought there to be offered, so they are left out.

keyTerms.meaning: The entrance of the Tent of Meeting (the place of offerings)
Fit, suitable
Liable to punishment

steps.whyThisMatters: This rule, "only what is fit for the אהל מועד," is the key to the whole new פרק. It decides which animals bring liability when offered outside.

phrases.english: As it is stated:
"And to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting he did not bring it"
anything that is not fit
to come to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting,
one is not liable for it.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives the source for the ruling in step 13.
steps.raayaObject: The exemption for the פרה אדומה and the שעיר המשתלח
steps.raayaSupportSource: ויקרא 17:4: "וְאֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לֹא הֱבִיאוֹ"

steps.title: A list of disqualified animals offered outside
steps.stepSummary: The משנה lists animals that can never be a קרבן, such as a רובע, נרבע, מוקצה, נעבד, מחיר, אתנן, כלאים, טריפה and יוצא דופן. Someone who offers any of them outside is פטור.
steps.simpleTranslation: An animal that mated with a person, an animal a person mated with, an animal set aside for idol worship, an animal that was worshipped, the price of a dog, a harlot's payment, a mixed breed, a טריפה, and an animal born by caesarean: if someone offered them outside, he is exempt.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה keeps adding cases where offering outside does not make a person liable. This time it lists animals that are disqualified from ever being a קרבן.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The prohibition of offering outside the עזרה only covers an animal that could have been brought inside. Every animal in this list is פסול for the מזבח, so offering it outside is not the forbidden act. The משנה will give the source in the next step.

keyTerms.meaning: An animal that mated with a person, or that a person mated with
An animal set aside for idol worship, or one that was itself worshipped
A harlot's payment, and the price received for a dog
An animal born from two different species
An animal with a fatal defect
An animal born by caesarean section

phrases.english: An animal that mated with a person, and one that a person mated with,
and one set aside for idol worship, and one that was worshipped,
and the price of a dog, [and a harlot's payment],
phrases.notes: Some versions don't have this word. The square brackets show it belongs in the corrected wording.

phrases.english: and a mixed breed, and a טריפה, and one born by caesarean;
if one offered them outside, he is exempt.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Adds a further list of exempt cases to the new פרק's opening rulings
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Offering animals that are permanently disqualified from the מזבח outside the עזרה carries no liability.

steps.title: The פסוק: only what can come before the משכן
steps.stepSummary: The משנה proves its ruling from the words לפני משכן ה׳: liability applies only to an animal that is fit to come before the משכן.
steps.simpleTranslation: As it says: "before the Tabernacle of ה׳." Anything that is not fit to come before the Tabernacle of ה׳, one is not liable for it.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה gives the source for exempting all the disqualified animals it just listed.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The פסוק about offering outside says the animal should have been brought "before the משכן." So the איסור only applies to an animal that could have been offered there. A רובע, טריפה and the rest could never be brought, so offering them outside carries no liability.

keyTerms.meaning: The Tabernacle of ה׳
Fit to come, meaning fit to be brought as a קרבן

phrases.english: As it is said: "before the Tabernacle of ה׳" –
anything that is not fit
to come before the Tabernacle of ה׳,
one is not liable for it.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Supplies the scriptural source for the list in step 15
steps.raayaObject: The exemption for offering disqualified animals outside
steps.raayaSupportSource: The words לפני משכן ה׳ in ויקרא 17:4
steps.whatToRemember: Offering outside is only forbidden for an animal that could have been offered inside. If the animal is unfit for the מזבח, there is no liability.

steps.title: Starting the case of blemished animals
steps.stepSummary: The משנה begins a new case about בעלי מומין, whether the blemish is permanent or not. The sentence continues past this point.
steps.simpleTranslation: Blemished animals: whether they have permanent blemishes, or...
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה is setting up its next ruling, about animals with a מום. The ruling itself comes on the next amud.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה divides blemished animals into types, starting with a permanent blemish. It will finish the list and give the ruling right after this.

keyTerms.meaning: Animals with a blemish
Permanent blemishes

phrases.english: Blemished animals –
whether permanently blemished ones, or

steps.triggerLanguage: בַּעֲלֵי מוּמִין – בֵּין בַּעֲלֵי מוּמִין קְבוּעִין
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves from permanently disqualified animals to a new category, blemished animals
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Introduces the case of בעלי מומין; the ruling follows in the continuation.
